primaryVisitorTask: Choose a truthful town, beach or wine-country plan and reach the right local operator or conditions source before travelling.

baseline.source: Two independent read-only reviewers inspected current public at 320/390/1440 plus content and primary operator sources. No full 23-criterion score was possible.
baseline.hardGates: All three visible CMS heroes had generic place-name alt, no visible credit and no item-level rights receipt; Shoreham CMS cover was only 540x312 on desktop. Dromana intro put first Crittenden vines in the 1970s and invented a fifteen-minute ferry; Red Hill South called Foxeys, Quealy and Lindenderry local despite addresses in Red Hill/Balnarring; Shoreham claimed a low-tide swimming pool and a Two Bays Trail connection, and omitted the lack of surf lifesaving. Ocean Eight venue asserted inconsistent hours, walk-ins, dog/BYO policy and a Verve Pinot Noir, while its contact page was labelled a reservation flow. Asset 159902/159905 file names say Ocean Eight but embedded title/city say Fires Creek Botanical Winery, Central Coast NSW; exact subject cannot be certified.

hypothesis: Replacing the three uncredited CMS covers with rights-recorded, correctly located images and correcting travel/locality/access claims will restore visual trust and reduce wrong-place and wasted-trip outcomes.
boundedChange: Use Visit Victoria asset 143775 (Dromana Pier), 143152 (Paringa Estate, Red Hill South) and 159891 (Ocean Eight, Shoreham) as credited place covers; guard their CMS hero slots and OG resolver against metadata-free overrides. Correct the three place guides, move Paringa to its published locality and remove an unverified map pin. Replace Ocean Eight disputed 159902/159905 images with region-consistent 159894 and retained gallery, correct its product/access/contact advice, and withdraw those two disputed files from current placements and the image map. Remove 159902 from the regional gallery, fix Paringa caption, and replace the linked Main Ridge article hero with a credited illustrative nearby photo while correcting its direct superlative/locality errors. Preserve original media library and unrelated pages. Replace Paringa Estate unreviewed sourced hero (including OG/schema/save card) with reviewed Visit Victoria asset 143157, correct all seven captions to Red Hill South, direct bookings to its operator-linked SevenRooms page and remove unsupported dog policy. Record reviewed Dromana asset 143775 in the image map.
metric: Full production build and Visit Victoria licence gate pass; generated town HTML/og:image uses exact credited local image with descriptive alt, no uncredited hero background or post-hydration swap; no false ferry/Quealy/Two Bays/Verve claims; Ocean Eight contact link is labelled as contact and current hours are not asserted. Independent local and exact public 320/390/1440 visual/factual review with no overflow or broken media. Full /100 score remains null until all criteria and hard gates are evidenced. Paringa visible hero, OG, schema and save-card images resolve to 143157, with Red Hill South captions and no unsupported dog promise.
rollback: Revert this bounded set19 commit if primary operator/media evidence contradicts a replacement, the new image harms task completion, or CI/live rendering regresses; retain source and negative provenance receipts.
